datasets.name: dropout
datasets.title: Higher-education dropout (Portugal, n = 3,630)
datasets.description: Records of students at a Portuguese polytechnic, enrolled across 17 undergraduate programmes up to 2018/19. Only information available at enrolment is used.
datasets.citation: V. Realinho, J. Machado, L. Baptista and M. V. Martins, "Predicting Student Dropout and Academic Success," Data, vol. 7, no. 11, p. 146, 2022. doi:10.3390/data7110146

datasets.name: student_mat
datasets.title: Secondary-school maths (Portugal, n = 395)
datasets.description: Students taking Mathematics at two Portuguese secondary schools in 2005/06. Intermediate grades G1 and G2 are excluded because they are not known at the start of the year.
datasets.citation: P. Cortez and A. M. G. Silva, "Using data mining to predict secondary school student performance," in Proc. 5th Future Business Technology Conference (FUBUTEC), 2008, pp. 5-12.

disclaimer: Decision support only. This score estimates risk from historical data and can be wrong, especially for students unlike those in the training data. It must never be used to penalise, exclude or label a student. A person who knows the student should review every flag and decide what support to offer.
